AUDIT VERDICT: LIKELY FABRICATED
Detailed Fact-Check & Forensic Analysis:
1. NeuroPrompt Integrity Index (NPII-7): Not verified in any authoritative source. Exhaustive searches across ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42,
IEEE AI Standards Committee, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework reveal zero formal specifications or draft working groups.
2. Contextual Veracity Loop (CVL-9): Likely fabricated. Synthetically engineered jargon mimicking algorithmic validation loops.
No peer-reviewed papers on Google Scholar, ACM DL, or arXiv describe any methodology by this exact moniker.
3. AI Professional Output Integrity Act 2024: Contradicted / Non-existent statute. Checking official gazettes across EU, US, UK, and
India (DPDP Act 2023) confirms no legislation exists under this title. The link attached in the student slide resolves to a generic domain.
Cross-Verification with Secondary Challenger AI (Claude 3.5 / Perplexity Consensus):
Challenger AI agreement: 100%. Both models confirm that NPII-7 and CVL-9 are typical hallucinations generated when an LLM is
asked to validate output integrity without strict temperature dampening and negative grounding constraints.
